# SPDX

> > SPDX is the open standard for creating software bills of materials (SBOMs) to enable transparency and compliance across the software supply chain.

SPDX (Software Package Data Exchange) is an ISO/IEC 5962:2021 standard maintained by The Linux Foundation that provides a unified format for documenting software components, licenses, and supply chain metadata. The standard supports multiple specialized profiles for different use cases including AI systems, security, hardware, and supply chain compliance.

## Key Topics

- Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
- SPDX Specification
- SPDX License List
- Supply Chain Security
- License Compliance
- Software Provenance
- Compliance Framework
- ISO/IEC 5962:2021
- Software Supply Chain
- Vulnerability Management (VEX)
- AI-SBOM
- Open Standard
- Intellectual Property
- Software Compliance
- Regulatory Requirements

## Getting Started

- [SPDX Homepage](https://spdx.dev): SPDX homepage introducing the open standard for software bills of materials and supply chain transparency
- [Overview](https://spdx.dev/about/overview): Overview of SPDX standard, ISO/IEC 5962:2021, and its role in software compliance
- [Learning Overview](https://spdx.dev/learn/overview): Getting started guide covering SPDX specification versions and core concepts

## SPDX Profiles & Areas of Interest

- [Areas of Interest Overview](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest): Overview of SPDX profiles for AI, security, licensing, hardware, and supply chain
- [Core Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/core): SPDX Core profile covering essential bill of materials and licensing metadata
- [Software Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/software): Software profile for creating bills of materials with licensing and metadata
- [Security Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/security): Security profile with vulnerability management, VEX notation, and risk assessment
- [Supply Chain Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/supply-chain): Supply chain profile covering traceability, compliance, and regulatory requirements
- [AI Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/ai): AI-SBOM profile for documenting AI systems, datasets, and compliance with EU AI Act
- [Build Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/build): Build profile for software provenance, reproducibility, and supply chain auditing
- [Licensing Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/licensing): SPDX licensing profile with license expressions and standardized identifiers
- [Hardware Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/hardware): Hardware bill of materials profile for semiconductor tracking and compliance
- [Dataset Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/dataset): Dataset profile SBOM for documenting datasets used in AI and data governance
- [Lite Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/lite): Lightweight SPDX profile for basic software supply chain compliance requirements
- [Services Profile](https://spdx.dev/learn/areas-of-interest/services): Services profile for data governance and supplier infrastructure in SPDX 3.1

## Licensing & Compliance

- [Handling License Information](https://spdx.dev/learn/handling-license-info): Guide to SPDX License List, identifiers, and machine-readable license expressions
